# Container Deployment Standards

This directory contains standards for containerizing applications and deploying them to container orchestration platforms.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/container/README.md#std-app-cnt-001-container-deployment]

### STD-APP-CNT-001: Container Deployment

Standards for building container images, managing dependencies, configuring containers, implementing health checks, and deploying to Kubernetes or other container platforms.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/container/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Consistent container image builds
- Secure and efficient containerization practices
- Proper resource allocation and limits
- Reliable deployment and orchestration
- Container image optimization and security scanning
